`REPEAT` Repeat – Cause the image to repeat horizontally and vertically. - `EXTEND` Extend – Extend by repeating edge pixels of the image. - `CLIP` Clip – Clip to image size and set exterior pixels as transparent. - `MIRROR` Mirror – Repeatedly flip the image horizontally and vertically. Type: Literal\[‘REPEAT’, ‘EXTEND’, ‘CLIP’, ‘MIRROR’\] image [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.ShaderNodeTexImage.html#bpy.types.ShaderNodeTexImage.image "Link to this definition")Type: [`Image`](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.Image.html#bpy.types.Image "bpy.types.Image") \| None image\_user [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.ShaderNodeTexImage.html#bpy.types.ShaderNodeTexImage.image_user "Link to this definition") Parameters defining which layer, pass and frame of the image is displayed (readonly, never None) Type: [`ImageUser`](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.ImageUser.html#bpy.types.ImageUser "bpy.types.ImageUser") interpolation [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.ShaderNodeTexImage.html#bpy.types.ShaderNodeTexImage.interpolation "Link to this definition") Texture interpolation (default `'Linear'`) - `Linear` Linear – Linear interpolation. - `Closest` Closest – No interpolation (sample closest texel). - `Cubic` Cubic – Cubic interpolation. - `Smart` Smart – Bicubic when magnifying, else bilinear (OSL only). Type: Literal\[‘Linear’, ‘Closest’, ‘Cubic’, ‘Smart’\] projection [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.ShaderNodeTexImage.html#bpy.types.ShaderNodeTexImage.projection "Link to this definition") Method to project 2D image on object with a 3D texture vector (default `'FLAT'`) - `FLAT` Flat – Image is projected flat using the X and Y coordinates of the texture vector. - `BOX` Box – Image is projected using different components for each side of the object space bounding box. - `SPHERE` Sphere – Image is projected spherically using the Z axis as central. - `TUBE` Tube – Image is projected from the tube using the Z axis as central. Type: Literal\[‘FLAT’, ‘BOX’, ‘SPHERE’, ‘TUBE’\] projection\_blend [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/bpy.types.ShaderNodeTexImage.html#bpy.types.ShaderNodeTexImage.projection_blend "Link to this definition") For box projection, amount of blend to use between sides (in \[0, 1\], default 0.0) Type: float texture\_mapping `REPEAT` Repeat – Cause the image to repeat horizontally and vertically. - `EXTEND` Extend – Extend by repeating edge pixels of the image. - `CLIP` Clip – Clip to image size and set exterior pixels as transparent. -
